purpose: Qualify the existing checked-in Eldyrwild adoption bundle as historical D_A design/rehearsal input only.

eligible_use: Review of this fixture's exact represented structure, metadata, and recorded lineage
Design of owner-led mapping and source/body disposition questions
A future separately approved D_A-only rehearsal limited to records represented by this exact fixture
not_satisfied: Gate 4 full cross-owner preservation proof readiness
Gate 5 exact target and implementation lease
not_authorized: A claim that this is a complete legacy export or complete current authority
Live database access, capture, writer fencing, restore, mutation, or cutover
External locator fetches, body reconstruction, fabricated spans, or source-policy changes
acceptance_boundary.completeness_rule: Owner attestation cannot turn an omitted required record into represented evidence. Any required-but-unrepresented record remains an explicit limitation, not a waiver; fixture-local omission does not prove absence in the source authority.

source_graph.meaning: Bundle source_provenance identity; not the adopted DungeonMind D_A revision.

stage_labels.distinction: Source-world revision 0c644..., adopted DungeonMind D_A 34b1..., and later DungeonMind D_B 680c... are different stage identities from different authority fields. Never collapse, substitute, or relabel them. The operator dump is not packaged or reclassified by this sidecar.

represented_in_candidate_bundle: The dm_union_graph_v6 payload identified by the source-world revision and payload digest above
93 adoption contributions and 13 adoption identity decisions
184 evidence references with exact artifact/revision IDs; all 26 distinct referenced pairs match exactly one bundle revision
not_represented_in_this_fixture: D_B and its complete current durable authority state
M0/M1 adoption/repair receipt lineage and repair sidecars
A complete later historical identity/source mutation ledger
Body bytes for any source revision
A capture/freeze interval or writer-fence witness
unknown_or_unattested_from_this_fixture: Whether this bundle contains every record required by a future V7 claim
Any omitted record's existence or absence in the source authority
External body availability, immutable retrieval, retention, rights, or access guarantees
The meaning of null artifact visibility or null source_visibility_state
Authority-owner approval of fixture selection, completeness, or provenance
scope_inventory.interpretation_rule: Not represented here means only that this candidate bundle does not contain that evidence; it does not prove the evidence or records are absent from the source authority.

source_body_design_disposition.default: Preserve exact artifact/revision IDs, metadata, digests, locators, and evidence-to-revision links. Treat body availability as unverified and non-openable. Do not fetch locators, reconstruct content, fabricate spans, or substitute artifact.current_revision_id for the revision named by evidence.
source_body_design_disposition.future_witness_rule: Any semantic/read witness requiring unavailable bytes remains blocked until the actual body owner supplies an authorized disposition and evidence. This design default creates no body-access contract and proves no active native source mapping.

does_not_attest: body availability, access, rights, or retention

buddy_export_and_domain_owner.required_scope: Fixture selection, producer/source provenance, bounded D_A coverage, and product/domain meaning

legacy_authority_operator_and_writer_own.required_scope: Actual authority, participating writers/stores, capture/freeze facts, and explicit approval or rejection of the bounded D_A design/rehearsal coverage

external_source_body_owners.required_scope: Exact bytes/access/retention facts for each actual external body store; no rights or openability guarantee is inferred

rehearsal_default.identity_metadata: Preserve exact IDs, metadata, digests, and evidence-to-source-revision linkage for records represented here.
rehearsal_default.unverified_external_body: Explicitly non-openable unless its actual owner establishes supported availability and access.
prohibited_shortcuts: Substitute current revision for the revision named by evidence
Map null visibility to public, GM, or any default audience
Infer complete source closure from bundle-local counts or hashes

verification_record.method: Read-only derivation from the exact fixture at git_commit; file SHA-256, Git blob, counts, and exact evidence/revision link matches are recorded for independent reproduction.

read_only_check_results.evidence_references: 184 references resolve to 26 distinct artifact/revision pairs; each pair matches exactly one revision row in the bundle
read_only_check_results.artifact_current_revision_links: 83 artifacts each link to exactly one revision row in the bundle
read_only_check_results.source_body_inventory: 83 revisions have external body_storage, a content digest and locator; no body bytes are present in the bundle
read_only_check_results.visibility_representation: All 83 artifact visibility and source_visibility_state fields are null; no audience meaning was inferred

verification_record.scope_limit: These checks establish only MIND-side parse/hash/fixture-internal linkage facts at the pinned input. They do not authenticate the source authority, prove completeness, or replace upstream owner attestations.
verification_record.runtime_or_migration_tests: Not applicable to this design-only qualification; no implementation behavior is claimed.
